;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[March 2017 Israel–Syria incident]], [[Israeli–Syrian ceasefire line incidents during the Syrian Civil War]]
**The [[Israeli Air Force]] [[March 2017 Israeli airstrikes in Syria|launches several airstrikes]] on targets inside [[Syria]], and for the first time, publicly claims responsibility. Syrian air defenses responded by launching missiles at the aircraft, and thereupon Israeli [[Arrow 3]] missiles were launched in response to the counter-offensive. Israel stated that it was targeting suspected weapons shipments to [[Hezbollah]] in [[Lebanon]], adding that the Israeli military will keep intervening until they believe such shipments have ceased. According to the [[Syrian Army]], four Israeli jets entered its airspace and struck targets near [[Palmyra]]. [http://www.cnn.com/2017/03/17/middleeast/israel-jets-syria-strikes/index.html (CNN)] [http://bigstory.ap.org/article/b0005340c957486e88144994668c34d8/syrian-missiles-fired-israeli-jets-struck-syria (AP)]
*[[Yemeni Civil War (2015-present)]]
**An unknown perpetrator using an [[Boeing AH-64 Apache|Apache helicopter]] fires upon a boat carrying Somali [[refugee]]s off the coast of Yemen, killing at least 40 of them, injuring 35 more. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-refugees-idUSKBN16O0UI (Reuters)] [https://web.archive.org/web/20170320000658/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/33-somali-refugees-shot-dead-on-red-sea-yemen-officials/ar-BByfsNR (AFP via MSN)]
*[[War in North-West Pakistan]]
**Gunmen raid a [[Pakistan]]i military post near the border with [[Afghanistan]], killing at least eight people. [[Jamaat-ul-Ahrar]], a faction of [[Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan]], claim responsibility. [http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/03/clashes-pakistan-afghanistan-border-kill-170317061451793.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Basque conflict]]
**In [[Spain]], the [[Basque nationalism|Basque]] separatist group [[ETA (separatist group)|ETA]] announces that it will fully disarm by April 8, 2017. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-39305685 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Heavy flooding in [[Peru]] kills at least 67 people and forces thousands to abandon their homes. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/mar/17/peru-floods-ocean-climate-change (''The Guardian'')]
